desc: Prove the pair-state recurrence and the correct orientation of matching outer-edge transitions.
Derive an efficient grouped transition implementation and assess its worst-case Python performance.
Validate initialization with empty paths, one-edge palindromes, self-loops, revisiting vertices, and unreachable pairs.
Implement input parsing, heap-based shortest-path computation, and formatted output.
Run the implementation against both provided samples and confirm the exact expected outputs.
